The '''Superlift Ore Hauler''', sometimes referred to as a '''Superlifter''', was a deep [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]] hauler. The vessel was manufactured by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. The ore hauler was slow, sluggish, unarmed, and had a tiny crew. It could carry 90,000 metric tons, cost 1.5 million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and was 155 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long.
